manual_basis: Installed manual physical pp225,476-478 defines ItemTransfer BETWEEN with real STFID/STTID, scheduled TFTIME, source stock demand, transport delay TFDT and nominal source/destination stock updates when performed. pp681-683 and 717 define tracked item-position STSZ/STOHA. Installed dictionary gives seven-column ItemTransfer schema.
controlled_design: Accepted I02.var01 IN parent retains h4 one-unit IN into DEPOT-01, Item.TRACK=Y, half-hour ITEM collection, seed1, E04 FAST support structure, and 36h horizon. Child appends one BETWEEN ItemTransfer DEPOT-01 to BASE-01 at h6, TFQTY1, TFDT0, and changes description. All 30 other tables unchanged. h4 IN makes two units at depot before h6 transfer; BASE starts with nominal stock0. This is a zero-delay BETWEEN after a preceding IN, not a standalone BETWEEN-only experiment.

pre_run_hypotheses.between: Native should create one BETWEEN task at h6, remove one physical LRU from DEPOT-01 and deliver it to BASE-01 with zero transfer duration. Tracked ItemResults for each item/station should show depot STSZ/STOHA 2→1 and base STSZ/STOHA 0→1 at h6 after accepted h4 IN. Exact physical item ID and output row details are conditional.
pre_run_hypotheses.later_demand: The later first aircraft failure may use the new local BASE spare rather than depot support; exact stock, failed-item repair/return route, mission outcome, report averages and terminal state must be reconciled from raw native evidence.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Converter rejection, delayed/split transfer despite available source, missing BASE item-position table, source/destination nominal or physical mismatch, duplicate transfer, report inconsistency or source/closure mismatch is diagnostic; no positive BETWEEN claim published.

acceptance_gates: Independent pre-run audit of accepted IN parent, manual/dictionary pins, frozen child source and exact two-table delta
Session-0 SSH native run under host-wide mutex preserving GUI PID13340
Exact authored-table roundtrip, zero conversion errors, valid SXO/report and sealed raw files
Physical BETWEEN departure/arrival ledger, direct depot and base ItemResults STSZ/STOHA changes at h6, conservation across both stations, later demand/repair and terminal state reconciled
Author replay, independent read-only replay and final staged audit before publication
limits: Positive result would cover one zero-delay available-stock BETWEEN of one LRU from depot to base after accepted IN, one seed. It would not establish standalone BETWEEN, nonzero delay, shortage split/backorder, transfer priority, reorder or procurement.
GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity remain unverified.
